title: Very cute; good quality; not quite a work of art; wonderful doorstop
text: Very cute; good quality; not quite a work of art; wonderful doorstop. This is really cute and makes a nice gift for someone who likes cats.  It is heavy enough to use for a doorstop and yet light enough to put on a shelf as either just a decoration or possibly to hang keys or some other item on.  Looks and feels durable, so doubt it would easily break, if at all.  It is cast iron after all.  Maybe a little pricey, but you are getting a quality product.  What's the downside?  It is solid black (blacker than it appears in the photo) and might have been a little nicer with some color added, even if just the cats eyes had some color.  If you are artistic, I suppose you could custom paint it yourself.  You need to be careful with this if you put it up on a low shelf as it is heavy enough to cause serious injury if pulled off the shelf by a young child and it falls on them.  I think it is best used on the floor either just as a decoration or as a doorstop.  I like it and recommend it, if you like this kind of thing.  I noticed this company makes a line of dancing pigs as well.
